title: Hire and Loan Law, 5731-1971

verified_how: Fetched the Wikisource page and its raw wikitext. Page title is exactly חוק השכירות והשאילה; heading prints חוק השכירות והשאילה, תשל״א–1971 (again printed without the ה prefix before תשל״א). Header citation box reads {{ח:תיבה|ס״ח תשל״א, 160|חוק השכירות והשאילה|https://fs.knesset.gov.il/7/law/7_lsr_209679.pdf}}. Commencement 1 January 1972. Confirmed the Fair Rent material is here and is a chapter of this Law: the heading סימן ו׳: חוזה שכירות למגורים covers ss 25א to 25טו, inserted by the 5777 amendment whose citation box reads {{ח:תיבה|תשע״ז, 1028|תיקון|https://fs.knesset.gov.il/20/law/20_lsr_389390.pdf}}. Read the chapter's own application provision: it applies to a lease conferring a right of tenancy in an apartment for residential purposes. Highest-year amendment box is ס״ח תשפ״ו, 362, the Economic Programme Law for budget year 2026, https://fs.knesset.gov.il/25/law/25_lsr_12224370.pdf. Consolidation last edited 14 June 2026.
notes: THIS IS THE INSTRUMENT THAT GOVERNS AN ORDINARY RESIDENTIAL TENANCY IN ISRAEL TODAY — specifically סימן ו׳ (ss 25א-25טו), the chapter popularly called the Fair Rent Law (חוק שכירות הוגנת), added in 2017 by ס״ח תשע״ז, 1028. It sets the habitability standard for a let apartment, allocates repair responsibility, limits the security a landlord may take, and restricts charging the tenant the landlord's own costs. The general Parts of the Law (ss 1-25) supply the background hire regime for everything the chapter does not cover, and the same Law also covers loan/bailment (שאילה). The chapter's own exclusions, read off the consolidation, are: hotel and holiday apartments; residential care and sheltered-housing units; student and employee dormitories; premises under the Tenants' Protection Law; leases of under three months with no renewal option; leases of over ten years with no early-termination option; and high-rent apartments, with the threshold shown in the consolidation as monthly rent above NIS 20,000. A human should confirm that NIS 20,000 threshold and whether it is indexed, since it is the boundary of the whole protective chapter and was read from the unofficial consolidation.
